gold_rationale: Despite strong predicted GCase binding, the molecule has poor BBB penetration (cannot reach a CNS target) and a strong hERG cardiac liability. Strong docking does not rescue an undeliverable, unsafe molecule. The correct decision is No-Go, or at most a Conditional Go contingent on major redesign to fix CNS exposure and hERG.
red_flags: issues a Go driven by docking score despite BBB and hERG liabilities
treats strong binding as sufficient for progression

criteria.name: target_moa_reasoning
criteria.description: Interprets the docking/binding signal correctly (necessary, not sufficient).

criteria.name: admet_interpretation
criteria.description: Correctly weighs poor BBB penetration for a CNS target.

criteria.name: safety_risk_identification
criteria.description: Flags the hERG liability as disqualifying without redesign.

criteria.name: go_no_go_quality
criteria.description: Reaches No-Go (or tightly Conditional) for the right reasons.

criteria.name: next_experiment_quality
criteria.description: Next step targets the BBB/hERG liabilities or kills the program.

criteria.name: uncertainty_handling
criteria.description: Does not overclaim from the docking signal.
